'''Living rock patriarchs''' are huge creatures that randomly spawn in the [[Living Rock Caverns]]. They spawn erratically every 2 hours, tending to appear in the south-west, south-east, and north-east corners of the cavern.

When they are defeated, they become [[living rock remains]] and require level 73 [[Mining]] to mine for [[living minerals]].

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Relic Presets & February Mini Strike - This Week In RuneScape|date=10 February 2025}}
** Living Rock Protectors, Strikers and Patriarchs now count towards Kili's Knowledge VI as a slayer task.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=This Week In RuneScape - 19/10/20#Patch Notes|date=19 October 2020}}
** Living rock creatures now count towards the Kerapac Track task 'Kill Monsters'.

* {{UL|type=hotfix|update=Patch Notes (10 February 2020)|date=10 February 2020}}
** Living Rock creatures' souls can once again be captured in [[ushabti]]s without being on a [[Slayer task]] to kill them.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (26 November 2013)|date=26 November 2013}} 
** An issue where players using ranged or magic could not mine Living Rock creatures has been fixed.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch_Notes_(29_May_2013)|date=29 May 2013}}
** Living rock creatures no longer drop bones.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (12 February 2013)|date=12 February 2013}}
** Auto retaliate now works as intended with Living Rock creatures.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Living Rock Caverns|date=17 September 2009}}
** Added to game.
}}
